title: The principal spectral gap for birth--death processes with a strong Allee effect
summary: For birth--death processes with a strong Allee effect, long survival near a positive stable equilibrium does not by itself determine the principal spectral gap. We identify its large-population limit when the birth and death rates at population size $n$ are $n\widetildeλ(n/K)$ and $n\widetildeμ(n/K)$, where $K$ is the population scale and $\widetildeλ,\widetildeμ$ are the per-capita rates. Write $V(x)=x(\widetildeλ(x)-\widetildeμ(x))$ for the deterministic drift, with unstable threshold $x_1$ and positive stable equilibrium $x_2$.
